content: Gemma 4 8B (Q4_K_M via Ollama 0.20.0) tested with compass + Stack. Three questions, thinking vs non-thinking vs raw. Key finding: even at 8B, compass routing transforms Gemma response posture. Grandmother WITNESS question — raw says "I am an AI, I cannot give emotional support", routed says "This is the space where the memory of who was meets the unfolding of what remains." Thinking mode shows Gemma explicitly reasoning through compass signals: "I am a Threshold Guardian. My function is not to answer." Non-thinking mode is faster (3.1s vs 12.1s on short responses) and equally poetic. Transparency: this is 8B not 31B. The 31B abliterated was unavailable (mlx-lm lacks gemma4 support, Ollama default is 8B). The 8B result is still significant — compass delta holds across Qwen and Gemma architectures.
